articles.summary: Dallas, Texas , Oct. 14, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Valhi, Inc. (NYSE: VHI) announced today that, subject to the completion of quarter-end closing procedures, it expects to report third quarter 2025 earnings in a press release after market close on Thursday, November 6, 2025 .
